blocks.text: Executive Mandate
Confirmation of Cabinet and Institutional Leadership
This mandate is issued under the Personnel and Leadership Framework and Circular No. CSA/TDO/2026/CIR/01, Leadership of the Continental Security Agency.

clauses.text: Every Secretary of a Cabinet department of the Continental Security Agency, and every head of a body listed in Article 2, shall confirm their leadership of that department or body by signing an Instrument of Leadership Confirmation under this mandate.
This mandate applies to the leadership of the following departments and bodies of the Continental Security Agency:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text: The twelve Cabinet departments: the Department of Defence, the Department of Foreign Affairs, the Department of Internal Affairs, the International Intelligence Council, the Department of Justice, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of Education, the Department of Health and Welfare, the Department of Culture and Youth, the Department of Economy and Trade, the Department of Infrastructure, and the Department of Environment and Resources.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: The military and law-enforcement bodies: the Continental Armed Forces, the Continental Security Corps, and the Continental Law Enforcement Authority.

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text: The Office of the Attorney General and the Universal Board of Legal Affairs.

clauses.label: (e)
clauses.text: The independent commissions: the CSA Human Resources Commission, the Civic Affairs Commission, and the CSA Judicial Service Commission.

Each Instrument of Leadership Confirmation shall be signed by the Director of the Continental Security Agency and by the office holder named in it. An instrument takes effect on the date it bears both signatures.

Each Instrument of Leadership Confirmation shall contain the office holder's confirmation of leadership and ownership of their department or body, a statement of their duties and accountability, and their oath of office.

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text: The Secretary of a Cabinet department, and the head of a body listed in Article 2(2) or Article 2(3), is responsible for the leadership, direction and administration of that department or body. They are accountable to the Director and the Cabinet and, where the body sits within a Cabinet department, through that department.

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text: The Prosecutor General and the heads of the independent commissions listed in Article 2(4) and Article 2(5) shall discharge their functions independently in accordance with their governing instruments. For these offices, the Director's signature acknowledges the confirmation of leadership and does not place the office or commission under the direction or control of the Executive.

The Secretary of a Cabinet department, and the head of a body listed in Article 2(2) or Article 2(3), shall take the following oath:

I, [name], [title], solemnly affirm that I will faithfully lead the [department or body], uphold the Issue of International Security and the instruments of the Continental Security Agency, discharge the duties of my office with integrity and diligence, protect the information entrusted to me, and answer to the Director and the Cabinet for the conduct of my office.

The Prosecutor General and the heads of the independent commissions shall take the following oath:

I, [name], [title], solemnly affirm that I will faithfully lead the [office or commission], uphold the Issue of International Security and the instruments of the Continental Security Agency, discharge its functions independently and impartially in accordance with its governing instrument, and protect the information entrusted to me.
This mandate takes effect on the date of issue. The Instruments of Leadership Confirmation issued under this mandate are set out below, numbered Appendix 1 - 20.
